text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers submit their code for review, a teammate carefully examines it before it is merged into the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, saving time and money that would otherwise be spent fixing issues later. Moreover, code reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. A junior developer can learn new techniques from a senior colleague, while the reviewer gains insight into other parts of the system. Ultimately, this practice raises the overall quality of the team, encouraging collaboration, accountability, and a shared standard of excellence.
